description: Propose THREE candidates for ONE role, the way a street-casting director does: the obvious face, the one you would walk past, and the one nobody would think of. Casting is choosing — this gives you something to choose from. It creates nothing: pick one and create it with lab_create_character, passing that candidate's `anlegen` fields (they include project_id). Costs an LLM run per call, so it is credit-gated, and every call draws NEW candidates (it is not cached on purpose). What the project material fixes (age, gender, …) is the same in all three; the answer's `spektrum` says whether they really differ (`ok`, `maengel`). Fail-open: no material, no AI key or an unusable answer comes back as an EMPTY list with a `note`, not an error — fewer than three candidates carry `note: unvollstaendig`.

notiz.description: What to know about the role that the material does not say, e.g. 'retired judge, buys the same roll every morning'. Without material, a note alone is enough.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string. Its script and cast module are the material.

rolle.description: The role to cast, usually the character's name, e.g. 'Ottmar'. It becomes the sheet name of every candidate.
